note: This catalogue is read at runtime by _fetch_live_data() to build _BBG_RAW, _REQUIRED_BBG, and _OPTIONAL_BBG. Do not use template notation — every fetched ticker must be an explicit entry. Treatment values: 'required' = any missing ticker triggers simulation fallback; 'optional_zero' = zeroed if absent, model assigns near-zero coefficient; 'optional_interp' = used when present, silently skipped/interpolated if absent (forward derivation inputs).
